description: This PHP class defines 'HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_StrictBlockquote', a class responsible for handling blockquote child elements in strict validation mode within the HTMLPurifier library. It reconfigures allowed elements and validates children nodes, ensuring proper structure during HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_StrictBlockquote
classes.description: A class for managing blockquote child elements during strict validation, customizing allowed elements, and validating the children nodes to ensure proper HTML structure.

methods.name: getAllowedElements
methods.description: Returns the list of elements allowed inside the blockquote based on configuration.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates and processes child nodes of the blockquote, wrapping inline nodes in a block wrapper as needed, according to strict validation rules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the object by setting up the allowed real and fake element sets based on the configuration.
